d: Ahead of the INDIA bloc's mega rally at Ramlila Maidan, Rahul Gandhi had appealed to visitors to support Delhi's local traders by shopping during the festive season. However, visiting Connaught Place, he alleged that the BJP had forcibly shut shops, causing losses to traders. Earlier, the Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) had warned that the rally could disrupt business, with around 2.5 lakh shops expected to remain closed within a 5-km radius of Ramlila Maidan.
